bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
BRANCH="chat/menu-link-creator-runtime-hotfix-20261115"
SHA="0bbf7c677a22dd63eeadb153404a1c0fdffa2ccb"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/gaybbs-creator-hotfix-20261115"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$SHA" || exit 74
if test -d "$WT"; then
 test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 76
 git -C "$WT" checkout --detach "$SHA"
else
 git worktree add --detach "$WT" "$SHA"
fi
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA" || exit 74
LIVE="deploy-gaybbs-1"
test "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 63
COMPOSE="$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 67
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy config -q
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-hotfix-0bbf7c6 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile' "$LOG"; then exit 51; fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$LOG"; then exit 52; fi
 if grep -Eq 'network is unreachable|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|TLS handshake' "$LOG"; then exit 53; fi
 exit 55
fi
container="$(docker create gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-hotfix-0bbf7c6)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
docker cp "$container:/app/gaybbs.mjs" "$LOG.bundle"
test -s "$LOG.bundle"
grep -q 'クリエーター投稿' "$LOG.bundle" || exit 81
grep -q 'dm:talk' "$LOG.bundle" || exit 82
grep -q 'dm:invite' "$LOG.bundle" || exit 83
grep -q 'dm:link' "$LOG.bundle" || exit 84
grep -q 'プロフ作成' "$LOG.bundle" || exit 85
rm -f "$LOG.bundle"
docker rm -f "$container"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
oldid="$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.Image}}')"
docker image tag "$oldid" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-creator-hotfix-20261115
newid="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-hotfix-0bbf7c6 --format '{{.Id}}')"
good=0
recover() {
 if test "$good" != 1; then
  docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-creator-hotfix-20261115 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || true
  docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
}
trap recover EXIT
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:creator-hotfix-0bbf7c6 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
 active="$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
 running="$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
 if test "$active" = "$newid" && test "$running" = true; then good=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$good" = 1 || exit 86
trap - EXIT
rm -f "$LOG"
echo GAYBBS_CREATOR_HOTFIX_DEPLOY=PASS
echo SOURCE_SHA="$SHA"
echo IMAGE_ID="$newid"
echo CONTAINER_RUNNING=YES
